searchText: I wouldn't do that I mean, let's not try to be extra confusing by making every packet a handshake attempt. So, if you say that we can just replace part of the 'proposal 2' IV with fixed bytes, I'm very happy about that. Because that would mean we don't even need to include it in the spec. Since the first 16 bytes of the proposal 2 format are just random data, it's OK if your client chooses to make them look like a QUIC header 🙂
